unverified: Everything that touches a real CUDA context: PBD material/system/buffer creation, memcpyHtoD upload, memcpyDtoH read-back, release order, solver behaviour; compiled on Windows legs, run only by the GPU golden test and the checklist on the GPU PC

From memory of PhysX 5.6.1 [M]: buffer position/velocity/phase pointers are device pointers updated by host-to-device copy plus raiseFlags; solver keeps particles in buffer order; setNbActiveParticles/raiseFlags between steps; release order of buffer, system, actor, material; PBF-snippet-derived offsets and max velocity
Preset values (water/sand/smoke) and particle spacing are untuned guesses
VRAM use per system and the cost of the per-step read-back were not measured
fetchResultsParticleSystem placement relative to read-back is from the PhysX snippets, untested on GPU
